title: Sloperator Ramblings!!
author: requiem
body:
First off, I'd like to state that this is a very fast and growing new field that is hard to adapt to. That is it's baseline nature so anything I say here, if I remain coherent, is subject to that.

AI doesn't breed slop itself, it's the low-iq users with big ideas that ai tells the user is grand. Imposter Syndrome and Dunning Kruger galore.
I've seen people build beautiful things with AI, and others just build the most atrocious 1 prompt thing and call it godly. Ego plays a role too I suppose, AI is also actively ripping people with over inflated ego's apart, almost in a glorious forced ascension! 

Idk, my brain keeps retreating what I want to truly say here because of my connection with some people who hate AI. Uhhhh it's not the tools that make a beautiful house, its the architect itself. I for example, love building and designing and thinking in systems, vs some ordinary person picks up ChatGPT and says "make no mistakes". Who really is the sloperator then? It's a new field, think more I guess, it's also not le cheating because you haven't adapted or refuse to adapt.

I also do see a point to be had of people claiming to be X Y and Z thanks to ai as pure slop, like an artist from prompting, which is mostly false unless you have hyperphantasia and genuinely paint through prompting (People can genuinely visualize things well here, I for one predict the inference of the AI to have it output more efficiently while also compacting my text).

AI, I've noticed, is also opening the eyes and metacognition of people globally (Usually reserved for trauma victims)--- Ugh, why can't I complete sentences that I have genuine basis on??? Fuck off trauma!

I've spoken to myself so much through inference and intuitions that speaking the same/translating to actual words is a chore and my brain genuinely doesn't want me to "come out" just yet. It's an odd observation with that "internal" language communes with an AI through flow states. It's fun to explore, at least! I haven't done it lately because I don't know if it'd risk psychosis, and I'm trying to avoid that at all costs atm.

From the internal me, AI is a good thing and it should stay. Just don't give dumb and egotistical people AI and all your problems are solved.
